title: Not All Graphs Are Maps: A Task-Agnostic Exploration Framework for Mobile GUI Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.22672v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern mobile GUI agents can perceive visible screens and execute local actions, but they still lack persistent app-specific navigation knowledge: where functions live, which pages contain them, and which screens are equivalent across repeated visits. We introduce TAG-Nav, a Task-Agnostic Graph Navigation framework that wraps existing GUI-agent backbones with reusable destination memory. Offline exploration is distilled into compact records of app functions, target pages, and waypoint routes before any evaluated instruction is seen. When a future task's destination is covered, TAG-Nav retrieves the destination and provides route guidance without task-specific demonstrations. This separates mobile GUI destination navigation from full task completion: many tasks share the prefix of reaching the right page, while final actions may enter content, send data, make purchases, delete information, or change sensitive settings. translated_title: 并非所有图都是地图：一种面向移动GUI导航的任务无关探索框架
translated_abstract: 现代移动GUI智能体能够感知可见屏幕并执行局部操作，但它们仍然缺乏持久的应用特定导航知识：功能位于何处、哪些页面包含这些功能、以及哪些屏幕在重复访问中是等价的。我们提出了TAG-Nav，一个任务无关的图导航框架，它通过可复用的目的地记忆来包装现有的GUI智能体骨干。在看到任何被评估的指令之前，离线探索被提炼成关于应用功能、目标页面和路径点路线的紧凑记录。当未来任务的目的地已被覆盖时，TAG-Nav检索该目的地并提供路线引导，而无需任务特定的演示。这将移动GUI目的地导航与完整任务完成分离开来：许多任务共享到达正确页面这一前缀，而最终操作可能是进入内容、发送数据、进行购买、删除信息或更改敏感设置。为了评估路线...
tldr: TAG-Nav是一个任务无关的图导航框架，通过将离线探索提炼为可复用的应用功能、目标页面和路线记忆，使GUI智能体无需任务特定演示即可完成目的地导航。
en_tdlr: TAG-Nav is a task-agnostic graph navigation framework that distills offline exploration into reusable destination memory, enabling GUI agents to navigate to destinations without task-specific demonstrations.
